Mbed TLS advisory 2026-03 reports a Clang select-optimize timing channel in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 and one-and-zeros unpadding; the production host uses GCC 12.2.0, and the generated OpenThread Mbed TLS configuration used by that build defines MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM and omits MBEDTLS_RSA_C, MBEDTLS_CIPHER_MODE_CBC and every cipher padding option. No upstream fix exists.
